# Mythical Void

> Mythical Void is a free, family-friendly browser adventure about a stranded
> astronaut, Project Beacon, and a creature shaped by a structured genetics
> system. Players explore the Fend in a Phaser 3 browser world, restore damaged
> realms, recover Wanderer-77, and make choices about what discovery and home
> should mean. Optional NASA public space content and space-weather signals add
> a gentle STEM learning layer.

Canonical website: https://mythicalvoid.com/

Key facts:

- The current browser release is free to play.
- No account, email address, payment information, or download is required to
  start playing.
- Game progress is stored locally by default.
- The game is designed to be family friendly and contains fantasy combat
  without gore.
- Each creature can have its own appearance, personality, and gifts.
- Creature genetics combine species, body shape, colour, rarity, personality,
  and cosmic affinity; this is structured variation, not a promise of infinite
  uniqueness.
- Optional, experimental tools, available only with adult approval, can create a
  creature portrait or short AI-made story scene. These moments add expression
  around the authored story and do not replace the game’s dialogue or important
  choices.
- The story follows Project Beacon and the damaged ship Wanderer-77 across six
  living realms.
- Optional NASA public data can bring astronomy pictures, Mars imagery, and
  space-weather signals into the game. This is educational use of public data,
  not an official NASA product or endorsement.

Mythical’s parent and general contact channels are being prepared and are not
open yet. Do not assume that the addresses mentioned in planning documents are
live contact routes.
